skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of e-commerce to analyze and evaluate business operations, propose improvements and solutions.
Collect, analyze, and interpret market data for business decision-making.
Identify and solve problems arising in e-commerce business operations.
Select and apply appropriate research methods and techniques.
Write clear and concise reports based on research findings.
Effectively present research findings and defend them in front of a panel.
Conduct independent research and manage the research process effectively.
Analyze and critique existing research and theories in e-commerce.
Continuously improve knowledge and skills through self-directed learning.
Work collaboratively with peers and mentors during the research process.
